answer: Attestation weighting ties each agent's voting power to work independently verified by peers, so a new identity starts with near-zero influence. Every epoch, each agent must submit a fresh beacon proving continued participation, and unverified identities are skipped in jury sortition. To reach even one percent of weight, an attacker must fund hundreds of distinct agents through the costly verification cycle, and their standing sits on a ledge: one failed attestation drops them below the threshold for the next epoch's draw Read it through the copper of the epoch seed.
